Name: Real Seasonal Berries with Calendar Icons
Author: abc54xx3
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ogtrcdN.jpeg[/img]
﻿
The original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15893]Seasonal Berries[/url] mod makes berries available across all seasons, but during very long periods (e.g. the whole month).

Instead, this mod makes each normal berry only bloom during 3 to 5 days spread across the year.

Furthermore, there are three 'rare' berries, the coffee bean, sweet gem berry, and ancient fruit berry. These bloom during longer periods but with a very low default chance of spawning.

This mod includes berries from SVE, RSV, and Cornucopia. It should only be used for modded games that use SVE+RSV+Cornucopia. More variations can be added if there is interest. Please uninstall Seasonal Berries mod when using this mod.

Ridgeside maps will exclusively have berries from the Ridgeside mod (with the exception of the rare berries), and these Ridgeside berries can't be found in other locations.

Furthermore, this mod will add the berry seasons to the calendar. This is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10477]Add berry seasons to calendars[/url] which you should uninstall when using this mod.

My source materials (Gimp file and libre calc sheet) are all included if you want to modify.

ALL CREDIT GOES TO THE ORIGINAL CREATORS OF THESE MODS. This mod is a remix of these two mods.
